notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla's aura-state CharProc layer changes how the unit's own BODY renders for the life of an aura: proc 14 translucency (Stealth 0.3, Invisibility/Fade 0.5, ghost, Shadowform, Banish) with the 1000 ms cubic ramp both ways, proc 1 body tint (Frostbolt chill blue, Immolate orange, poison green), proc 11 animation freeze (Ice Block holds the pose), plus display-row base alpha (Ghost Wolf's CreatureModelAlpha 102). MSUI parses SpellVisualKit CharProcs (Formats/SpellVisualCatalog.cs) but consumes ONLY the type-9 emitter proc; there is no code path applying alpha, tint, or an anim-rate freeze to a unit's model - a stealthed player renders fully opaque, Ice Block does not freeze the pose, no chill/poison tint ever shows.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: The OTHER half of a state kit - attach-point effect models keyed by aura slots (StageLife.AuraState) - IS implemented in SpellEffectSource.cs; only the body-render CharProc half is absent.
